newsitem.title: USA: Rep. Leach optimistic on balanced budget, medicare.
newsitem.headline: Rep. Leach optimistic on balanced budget, medicare.

text.p: House Banking Committee Chairman James Leach, R-Iowa, Tuesday expressed optimism on the next Congress reaching a balanced budget and Medicare compromise.
"There is simply no credible reason that a balanced budget cannot be reached in an orderly time frame and no credible reason a thoughtful compromise on Medicare cannot be achieved," Leach said.
